name: oddly-angled-room-1
prompt: A single patch of the earth mound at the centre of the floor has been scuffed and flattened, as though something heavy was set down on it and taken away again.
extra: The wrong-angled walls, the floor, the glowing fungus and the shadowless even light are unchanged.

name: oddly-angled-room-2
prompt: A second patch of the earth mound has now been scuffed flat, a little way round from the first.
extra: The first scuffed patch remains exactly as it was; nothing else in the room has changed.

name: oddly-angled-room-3
prompt: A third patch of the earth mound has been scuffed flat, continuing round the mound from the first two.
extra: The first two scuffed patches remain exactly as they were.

name: oddly-angled-room-home
prompt: A fourth and final patch has been scuffed flat, completing a rough circuit of four marks around the mound, and a narrow dark opening has appeared low in the far wall that was not there before.
extra: All three earlier scuffed patches remain exactly as they were; the wrong-angled walls and the shadowless light are unchanged.

name: wizards-quarters-b
prompt: The scattered papers on the desk and floor are different papers, arranged differently, and the objects on the desk have been moved about — a different day in the same room.
extra: The bed, the desk, the candle and their exact positions are unchanged; only the loose papers and small objects differ.

name: wizards-quarters-c
prompt: The loose papers have been gathered into an untidy stack and the blankets on the bed have been pulled roughly straight.
extra: The bed, the desk, the candle and their exact positions are unchanged.

name: wizards-quarters-d
prompt: The stack of papers has been knocked over and spilled across the floor, and the candle has burned down to a stub in a pool of wax.
extra: The bed, the desk and their exact positions are unchanged.

name: depository-curtain-north
prompt: The whole of the far wall — every stone of it, corner to corner and floor to ceiling — has become an unbroken flat plane of cold white light, like a sheet of frosted glass lit from behind. It is a wall, not a doorway and not an opening: there is no arch, no frame, no gap, nothing beyond it, just a solid wall-sized rectangle of even cold light.
extra: The vault ribs and their spacing, the flagged floor and the other three walls are unchanged and remain ordinary stone.

name: depository-curtain-east
prompt: The plane of cold white light has moved: the far wall is ordinary dressed stone again, and now the entire right-hand wall is the unbroken flat sheet of cold light, floor to ceiling, still a solid wall and not an opening.
extra: The light renders exactly as it did on the far wall; only which wall carries it has changed.

name: depository-curtain-south
prompt: The plane of cold light has moved again: the right-hand wall is ordinary stone once more, and now the wall behind the viewer is lit, so the vault ribs are thrown into sharp relief from behind and the far wall is brightly lit from the camera's side.
extra: No wall in view carries the light itself this time; the whole room is lit from behind the viewer.

name: depository-curtain-west
prompt: The plane of cold light has moved to the left-hand wall: the entire left wall is now the unbroken flat sheet of cold light, floor to ceiling, and the right-hand wall is ordinary stone again.
extra: The light renders exactly as it did on the right-hand wall, mirrored.
